title: Kerala Buildings (Lease and Rent Control) Act, 1965
purpose: The Act regulates leasing, rent fixation, and eviction of tenants in Kerala.
scope: Applies to residential and non-residential buildings across Kerala where tenancy exists or is intended.
key_provisions: Rent Control Courts determine fair rent and adjudicate tenant-landlord disputes.
Landlords are prohibited from collecting rent exceeding the fair rent.
Eviction can be ordered only on specified legal grounds such as default, subletting, or bona fide occupation.
Tenants may deposit rent directly to court if refused by landlords.
administration: Rent Control Courts and Accommodation Controllers appointed by the State Government supervise enforcement.

title: Kerala Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Rules, 2009
purpose: The Rules provide procedures to ensure maintenance and welfare of elderly citizens.
scope: Covers senior citizens and parents residing in Kerala who are unable to maintain themselves.
key_provisions: Defines application procedures for maintenance before a Tribunal.
Conciliation Officers mediate settlements between elders and responsible children or relatives.
District Magistrates oversee protection of senior citizens’ life and property.
Old age homes are managed under notified schemes for indigent elders.
administration: Social Welfare Department implements rules through Tribunals, District Committees, and State Councils on Senior Citizens.

title: Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
purpose: The Act governs the levy and collection of tax on intra-State supply of goods and services.
scope: Applies to all taxable persons engaged in intra-state supply within Kerala.
key_provisions: Tax imposed on supply of goods or services based on value addition.
Input tax credit available subject to prescribed conditions.
Registration, returns, and compliance procedures align with national GST framework.
Provisions for audits, assessments, offences, and appeals are detailed.
administration: Administered by the Kerala State GST Department under the supervision of the Commissioner of State Tax.

title: Kerala Value Added Tax Act, 2003
purpose: The Act regulates tax on sale and purchase of goods based on value addition.
scope: Covers manufacturers, traders, and dealers in Kerala engaged in taxable sales.
key_provisions: Tax payable on sale value of goods after deducting input tax.
Mandatory registration for dealers above prescribed turnover limits.
Detailed classification of goods under different tax rates.
Provisions for refunds, exemptions, offences, and appeals defined.
administration: Enforced by the Commercial Taxes Department of Kerala through designated assessing authorities.

title: Kerala Civil Services (Classification, Control & Appeal) Rules, 1960
purpose: The Rules classify government services and regulate disciplinary control.
scope: Applies to all State Government employees except those specifically excluded.
key_provisions: Categories of services and posts defined.
Disciplinary procedures for misconduct and penalties specified.
Mechanism for appeals, reviews, and suspension orders laid down.
administration: Departmental heads and disciplinary authorities under Kerala Public Service Department manage enforcement.

title: Kerala Local Fund Audit Act, 1994
purpose: The Act ensures accountability and transparency in management of local fund institutions.
scope: Applies to Panchayats, Municipalities, Universities, and other entities using local funds.
key_provisions: Auditor-General for Local Fund conducts financial and compliance audits.
Irregularities must be reported to the government and concerned authority.
Provisions exist for surcharge recovery from responsible officials.
administration: Supervised by the Directorate of Local Fund Audit under the Finance Department.

title: Kerala Paper Lotteries (Regulation) Rules, 2005
purpose: The Rules regulate conduct, sale, and operation of paper lotteries within Kerala.
scope: Applies to State-authorized lotteries and registered agents.
key_provisions: Rules prescribe printing, sale, and draw procedures.
Agents require government authorization for operations.
Prize claim and result publication processes standardized.
administration: Regulated by the State Lotteries Department, Taxes Department, Government of Kerala.

title: Kerala Money-Lenders Act, 1958
purpose: The Act governs licensing and regulation of money-lending practices in Kerala.
scope: Covers all persons or firms engaged in money-lending for profit.
key_provisions: Mandatory license required for operating as a money lender.
Registers of loans and interest rates maintained.
Court jurisdiction provided for disputes regarding lending contracts.
administration: Licensing and enforcement carried out by the Registrar of Money Lenders under the Taxes Department.

title: Kerala Fish Seed Act, 2014
purpose: The Act ensures quality control, production, and distribution of fish seeds across Kerala.
scope: Applies to all fish hatcheries, dealers, and fish farmers within the State.
key_provisions: Registration mandatory for all hatcheries and dealers.
Quality standards for breeding and sale of fish seed specified.
Provision for inspection, sampling, and penalties for substandard fish seed.
administration: Administered by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Kerala.

title: Kerala Public Service Commission (Additional Functions as Respects the Lok Ayukta) Act, 2014
purpose: The Act assigns additional advisory and administrative functions to the PSC concerning the Lok Ayukta.
scope: Covers consultation and assistance tasks related to Lok Ayukta appointments and service matters.
key_provisions: PSC provides consultation on personnel-related processes for Lok Ayukta office.
Procedures for recruitment and disciplinary control incorporated.
Ensures independence and transparency in Lok Ayukta staffing.
administration: Kerala Public Service Commission administers the functions in liaison with the Office of the Lok Ayukta.

title: Kerala Cashew Factories (Requisitioning) Act, 1979
purpose: The Act enables requisitioning of cashew factories leased to the Kerala State Cashew Development Corporation to maintain operations and protect workers’ interests.
scope: Applies statewide to cashew factories leased or managed by the Kerala State Cashew Development Corporation.
key_provisions: Allows continued possession and management by the Corporation if lease terms expire or owners refuse extension.
Prevents owners from resuming possession leading to factory closure or improper management.
Ensures workers’ employment and factory operation are not disrupted.
administration: Implemented by the Kerala State Cashew Development Corporation with government oversight.

title: Kerala Cashew Factories (Acquisition) Act, 1974
purpose: The Act provides for acquisition of certain cashew factories in public interest to secure employment and just service conditions for workers.
scope: Extends to all cashew factories within Kerala under acquisition orders.
key_provisions: Defines acquisition procedures including the appointed day, compensation, and takeover of assets.
Ensures factories function under government or cooperative management post-acquisition.
Secures workers’ rights and maintains continuity of employment.
administration: Administered by government-appointed officers and agencies under the Factories Act framework.

title: Kerala (Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes) Regulation of Issue of Community Certificates Act, 1996
purpose: The Act regulates the issuance of community certificates to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to prevent fraudulent claims.
scope: Applies to all persons claiming Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe status in Kerala.
key_provisions: Prescribes strict procedural safeguards and verification for issuing certificates.
Penalizes fraudulent obtaining or misuse of community certificates.
Empowers designated authorities to issue, suspend, or cancel certificates.
administration: Enforced by Revenue Department officers and other notified authorities in Kerala.

title: Kerala Marine Fishing Regulation Act, 1980
purpose: The Act regulates marine fishing activities by vessels along Kerala’s coastline to ensure sustainable fisheries management.
scope: Applies to all fishing vessels, fishermen, and related activities within Kerala’s marine waters.
key_provisions: Establishes licensing and operational norms for fishing vessels.
Defines closed seasons, fishing zones, and restricted practices.
Specifies penalties and adjudication procedures for violations.
administration: Administered by the Fisheries Department with specified adjudicating officers.

title: Marine Fishing Regulation Rules, 1980
purpose: The Rules detail procedures and standards to support the Kerala Marine Fishing Regulation Act, 1980.
scope: Applies to fishermen, fishing vessels, and marine fishing operations in Kerala.
key_provisions: Specifies licensing criteria, vessel registration, and gear use restrictions.
Defines enforcement mechanisms and reporting requirements.
Mandates adherence to seasonal and spatial fishing restrictions.
administration: Implemented by Fisheries authorities under the State Government.

title: Kerala Cooperative Societies Act, 1969
purpose: The Act provides legal framework for registration, governance, and regulation of cooperative societies in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all cooperative societies registered or functioning in Kerala.
key_provisions: Prescribes procedures for registration, management, and audits.
Defines rights, duties, and dispute resolution mechanisms for members.
Empowers Registrar of Cooperative Societies for supervision and enforcement.
administration: Administered by the Registrar of Cooperative Societies under the Cooperation Department.

title: Kerala High Court Sevak Rules, 2017
purpose: The Rules govern appointment, conditions of service, and duties of court sevaks in the Kerala High Court.
scope: Applies to all sevaks employed by the Kerala High Court.
key_provisions: Defines recruitment qualifications and service obligations.
Specifies working hours, conduct standards, and disciplinary actions.
Sets guidelines for leave, salary, and promotion.
administration: Managed by the Registrar General of the Kerala High Court.

title: Kerala Panchayat Building (Regularisation of Unauthorised Construction) Rules, 2018
purpose: The Rules provide a scheme for regularizing unauthorized constructions in panchayat areas made before July 31, 2017.
scope: Applies to all unauthorized buildings within Gram Panchayat jurisdictions statewide.
key_provisions: Defines application process for regularization and fees payable.
Specifies criteria for structural safety and zoning compliance.
Provides timelines and penalties related to unauthorized constructions.
administration: Implemented by Panchayat authorities under the Local Self-Government Department.

title: Kerala Tolls Act, 1976
purpose: The Act authorizes collection of tolls on certain roads and bridges in Kerala for maintenance funding.
scope: Applies to designated toll roads, bridges, and motorists using them.
key_provisions: Prescribes toll rates and exemptions.
Provides powers for toll collection and penalty for evasion.
Enables toll funds to be utilized for infrastructure upkeep.
administration: Administered by the Public Works Department, Government of Kerala.

title: Kerala Arbitration and Conciliation (Court) (Amendment) Rules, 2017
purpose: The Rules amend procedures related to arbitration and conciliation conducted under Kerala courts.
scope: Applies to arbitration cases filed and conducted within Kerala’s judicial framework.
key_provisions: Modifies fee structures, timelines, and arbitral appointment processes.
Enhances procedural transparency and accessibility.
Clarifies powers of court in arbitration-related disputes.
administration: Implemented by Kerala High Court and subordinate judiciary.

title: Kerala Municipality Act, 1994
purpose: The Act governs urban local bodies including municipalities for civic administration and urban planning.
scope: Applies to all municipalities and corporations constituted under the Act in Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines powers and functions of municipal authorities.
Specifies taxation, licensing, public health, and building regulations.
Establishes mechanisms for public participation and grievance redressal.
administration: Administered by the Department of Local Self Government (Urban).

title: Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Kerala) Rules, 2018
purpose: The Rules detail application of Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) in family and inheritance matters in Kerala.
scope: Applies to Muslim community members subject to personal law jurisdiction.
key_provisions: Prescribes procedures for application of Shariat law in civil disputes.
Defines roles of Quazi and appointed officials in adjudication.
Provides appeal and enforcement mechanisms within State legal framework.
administration: Implemented under the supervision of the Kerala Waqf Board and Law Department.

title: Kerala Minimum Wages Rules, 1958
purpose: The Rules specify minimum wages payable to scheduled employment workers in Kerala.
scope: Applies to workers employed in scheduled industries and establishments.
key_provisions: Defines categories of employment and corresponding wage rates.
Provides for wage revision and dispute settlement procedures.
Enables enforcement through labor officers and courts.
administration: Managed by the Labour Department, Government of Kerala.

title: Kerala Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1976
purpose: The Act governs levy and collection of motor vehicle taxes in Kerala.
scope: Applies to owners of motor vehicles registered or used in Kerala.
key_provisions: Specifies tax rates based on vehicle types and usage.
Provides procedures for payment, penalties, and exemptions.
Empowers authorities to enforce compliance and prosecute defaulters.
administration: Administered by the Transport Department of Kerala.

title: Kerala Panchayat Raj (Issue of Licence to Factories, Trades, Entrepreneurship Activities and Other Services) Rules, 1996
purpose: The Rules regulate issuance of licenses by Panchayats for factories, trades, and entrepreneurial activities.
scope: Applicable to entities operating businesses under Panchayat jurisdiction.
key_provisions: Defines licensing application procedures, fees, and conditions.
Specifies inspections and penalties for non-compliance.
Promotes local economic activities under regulatory supervision.
administration: Implemented by Local Self-Government institutions in Kerala.

title: Kerala Panchayat Raj (Profession Tax) Rules, 1996
purpose: The Rules govern collection and administration of profession tax by Panchayat bodies.
scope: Applies to professionals and tradespersons taxable under Panchayat jurisdiction.
key_provisions: Specifies categories of taxable professions and rates.
Defines return filing and payment schedules.
Provides enforcement and penalty provisions for evasion.
administration: Administered by Panchayat Finance authorities under Kerala’s Local Government framework.

title: Kerala Road Safety Authority Act, 2007
purpose: The Act establishes the Kerala Road Safety Authority to improve road safety and reduce accidents.
scope: Applies to road users, transport vehicles, and traffic enforcement agencies in Kerala.
key_provisions: Constitutes the Authority with powers to enforce road safety laws and standards.
Promotes public awareness, driver training, and road safety audits.
Implements policies on vehicle fitness, licensing, and accident investigation.
administration: Managed by the Kerala Road Safety Authority under the Transport Department.

title: Kerala Tax on Luxuries Act, 1976
purpose: The Act provides for the levy and collection of tax on luxuries in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all luxury establishments such as hotels, houseboats, clubs, and similar institutions providing luxury amenities in Kerala.
key_provisions: Luxury tax levied on accommodation and facilities exceeding specified standards.
Assessment and appeal procedures aligned with Kerala General Sales Tax structure.
Hospitals and resorts charging premium fees are liable for luxury tax.
administration: Administered by the Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Kerala.

title: Kerala Panchayat Buildings Rules, 2011
purpose: The Rules ensure regulation, planning, and construction standards of buildings under village panchayats.
scope: Applies to all buildings and construction activities within the jurisdiction of Kerala’s Village Panchayats.
key_provisions: Defines building lines, structural safety, and setback distances from roads.
Specifies permit requirements, site plans, and occupancy certificates.
Provides classification of panchayats and penalties for unauthorized structures.
administration: Implemented by the Local Self-Government Department through Village Panchayat Secretaries and Town Planning Officers.

title: Kerala Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017
purpose: The Rules prescribe the implementation framework of Kerala State GST Act.
scope: Applies to registered taxable persons under the Kerala GST system for intra-state supplies.
key_provisions: Details maintenance of accounts, invoicing, returns, and audit requirements.
Defines procedures for input tax credit, refunds, and assessment.
Specifies penalties, appeals mechanism, and electronic filing standards.
administration: Implemented by the State GST Department under Commissionerate of Commercial Taxes.

title: Kerala General Sales Tax Act, 1963
purpose: The Act consolidates taxation on sale and purchase of goods in Kerala.
scope: Governs dealers and businesses engaged in sale transactions within Kerala before the introduction of VAT and GST.
key_provisions: Provides for registration of dealers and levy of sales tax on taxable turnover.
Specifies exemptions, returns, assessment, and appellate procedures.
Empowers the Government to fix rates and issue exemptions by notification.
administration: Monitored by the Commercial Taxes Department of Kerala.

title: Kerala Prohibition of Charging Exorbitant Interest Act, 2012
purpose: The Act prevents lending money at excessive interest rates and penalizes exploitative lenders.
scope: Applies to all money lenders and non-banking financial entities in Kerala other than banks.
key_provisions: Limits interest rates to two percent above the rates approved by the Reserve Bank of India.
Imposes imprisonment up to three years and fines up to Rs. 50,000 for violators.
Defines criminal liability for harassment or borrower suicide cases.
administration: Supervised by law enforcement authorities and implemented through the judicial system under State Government oversight.

title: Kerala Local Fund Audit Rules, 1996
purpose: The Rules define auditing procedures for local funds managed by public authorities.
scope: Covers local self-government bodies and other institutions utilizing local funds.
key_provisions: Defines audit scheduling, report submission, and recovery of losses through surcharge.
Empowers the Director of Local Fund Audit to issue charge certificates for losses.
Prescribes uniform procedures for audit compliance and documentation.
administration: Managed by the Directorate of Local Fund Audit under the Finance Department.

title: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Kerala) Rules, 2014
purpose: The Rules operationalize land acquisition, fair compensation, and rehabilitation frameworks in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all land acquisitions made by the State Government or its agencies.
key_provisions: Mandates Social Impact Assessment studies before acquisition.
Specifies procedures for consent, compensation, and rehabilitation of affected families.
Defines structure of Rehabilitation and Resettlement Committees and Monitoring Authorities.
administration: Administered by the Revenue Department through the Land Acquisition Officer and District Collector.

title: Kerala Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1991
purpose: The Act governs taxation on agricultural income derived from land in Kerala.
scope: Applies to individuals, families, and entities earning agricultural income within Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines agricultural income as revenue from land or produce processed for market.
Lays down computation methods, exemptions, and filing requirements.
Empowers Government to notify rates and concessions through Gazette.
administration: Managed by the Agricultural Income Tax Department under the State Finance Department.

title: Travancore-Cochin Indebted Agriculturists Relief Act, 1956
purpose: The Act provides relief to agriculturists from indebtedness through restructuring and debt scaling.
scope: Applies to agriculturists from the former Travancore-Cochin region.
key_provisions: Specifies procedures for declaring agriculturist debt relief.
Provides debt scaling formula and installment repayment framework.
Prohibits interest accumulation on restructured debts.
administration: Implemented through designated civil courts under the supervision of the Revenue Department.

title: Kerala Document Writers, Scribes and Stamp Vendors Welfare Fund Act, 2012
purpose: The Act establishes a welfare fund for registered document writers, scribes, and stamp vendors.
scope: Applies to all registered document writers, stamp vendors, and scribes working in Kerala.
key_provisions: Contributions collected from members, government grants, and registration renewals.
Welfare fund utilized for pensions, medical aid, and family benefits.
Board constituted to manage financial assistance and membership.
administration: Administered by a statutory Welfare Fund Board under the Registration Department.

title: Kerala Lifts and Escalators Act, 2013
purpose: The Act ensures safety, licensing, and inspection of lifts and escalators in Kerala.
scope: Applies to installation, operation, and maintenance of lifts and escalators across the State.
key_provisions: Mandatory registration and approval for installation and modification.
Periodic inspection by authorized officers and engineers.
Penalties prescribed for operation without valid certificate.
administration: Implemented by the Electrical Inspectorate under the Government of Kerala.

title: Kerala Ground Water (Control and Regulation) Act, 2002
purpose: The Act regulates extraction, conservation, and management of groundwater in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all commercial and non-commercial users of groundwater resources.
key_provisions: Registration required for wells, borewells, and tube wells.
Ground Water Authority empowered to issue permits and track extraction.
Prohibits overexploitation in notified critical areas.
administration: Managed by the Kerala Ground Water Authority under the Water Resources Department.

title: Kerala Agricultural Income Tax Rules, 1991
purpose: The Rules implement procedural and computation frameworks for agricultural income tax.
scope: Applies to taxpayers under the Kerala Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1991.
key_provisions: Defines allowable deductions such as depreciation and replantation allowance.
Specifies return filing, assessment forms, and appeal procedures.
Authorizes State Representatives to appear before the Tax Tribunal.
administration: Executed by Agricultural Income Tax Officers across the State.

title: Kerala Protection of River Banks and Regulation of Removal of Sand Act, 2001
purpose: The Act regulates removal of sand to conserve river ecosystems and prevent bank erosion.
scope: Covers all rivers, backwaters, and sand removal operations in Kerala.
key_provisions: Establishes River Management Committees to oversee extraction limits.
Prohibits unauthorized sand mining and transport.
Provides penalties for illegal removal and environmental damage.
administration: Administered by the Department of Environment and Forests with local enforcement support.

title: Kerala Panchayat Raj (Amendment) Act, 2014
purpose: The Amendment modifies provisions in the Panchayat Raj framework for local governance improvements.
scope: Applies to Gram Panchayats, Block Panchayats, and District Panchayats functioning under Kerala Panchayat Raj Act, 1994.
key_provisions: Introduces participatory planning and streamlined licensing procedures.
Empowers Panchayats with enhanced financial autonomy and transparency mandates.
administration: Implemented through the Local Self-Government Department and Panchayat Directorates.

title: Kerala Medical Education (Regulation and Control of Admission to Private Medical Educational Institutions) Act, 2017
purpose: The Act regulates admission, fees, and transparency in private medical institutions in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all self-financing medical colleges offering MBBS and allied courses in Kerala.
key_provisions: Admissions to private medical colleges based on NEET merit list.
Fee structure determination under a government-appointed committee.
Provisions for audits, penalties, and cancellation of recognition for violations.
administration: Overseen by the Admission Supervisory Committee for Professional Colleges, Kerala.

title: Kerala Municipality Building Rules, 1999
purpose: The Rules shape urban planning, building safety, and construction control in municipal areas.
scope: Applicable to all municipalities and corporations in Kerala.
key_provisions: Regulates zoning, floor area ratios, and structural safety measures.
Prescribes building permits, occupancy rules, and revised environmental norms.
administration: Administered by Urban Local Bodies under the Department of Urban Affairs.

title: Kerala Conservation of Paddy Land and Wetland Act, 2008
purpose: The Act restricts conversion and reclamation of paddy fields and wetlands in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all paddy lands, wetlands, and related agricultural areas across Kerala.
key_provisions: Prohibits conversion without approval from Local Level Monitoring Committees.
Classifies paddy land and wetland registers under Local Self-Government bodies.
Provides penalties and restoration directives for unauthorized conversions.
administration: Enforced by the Agricultural Department and Revenue Authorities through local monitoring committees.

title: Kerala High Court (Fee Payable to Arbitrators) Rules, 2017
purpose: The Rules prescribe fee structures and allowances for arbitrators appointed by the Kerala High Court.
scope: Applies to arbitration proceedings conducted under the supervision of the Kerala High Court.
key_provisions: Specifies arbitration fee schedule based on claim value.
Defines payment procedures, cost allocation, and reimbursement norms.
administration: Managed by the Registrar General, High Court of Kerala.

title: Kerala Irrigation and Water Conservation Act, 2003
purpose: The Act consolidates and amends laws relating to construction of irrigation works, conservation and distribution of water for irrigation, and levies betterment contribution and water cess on benefited lands.
scope: Extends to the whole of Kerala, covering irrigation systems and water use for agriculture.
key_provisions: Regulates construction and maintenance of irrigation facilities.
Involves farmers in water utilization management.
Imposes restrictions on water abstraction and sand quarrying in watercourses.
Constitutes authorities for dam safety and water management.
administration: Implemented by the Water Management and Utilisation Board and Kerala Dam Safety Authority under the State Government.

title: Kerala State Higher Education Council Act, 2007
purpose: The Act establishes the Kerala State Higher Education Council to coordinate higher education policies and promote academic excellence and social justice.
scope: Covers all higher education institutions and universities in Kerala.
key_provisions: Ensures autonomy and accountability of institutions.
Provides academic inputs for state policy formulation and planning.
Guides growth of higher education aligned with socio-economic needs.
administration: The Council operates as a collective of government, universities, academicians, and public representatives.

title: Kerala University Act, 1974
purpose: The Act reorganizes the University of Kerala as a teaching, residential, and affiliating university.
scope: Applies to the University of Kerala and its affiliated colleges.
key_provisions: Defines the University’s powers, duties, and governance structure.
Establishes academic bodies like the Academic Council.
Empowers the university to grant degrees, fix fees, and conduct examinations.
administration: Governed by the University Senate, Syndicate, and Vice-Chancellor under State Government rules.

title: Kerala Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1960
purpose: The Act regulates employment conditions and work hours in shops and commercial establishments across Kerala.
scope: Applies to all shops and commercial businesses in Kerala employing workers.
key_provisions: Mandatory registration of establishments.
Sets limits on working hours, holidays, and leave entitlements.
Authorizes inspectors and appellate authorities for enforcement.
Penalties for non-compliance are prescribed.
administration: Administered by designated inspectors under the Labour Department.

title: Kerala Panchayat Raj Act, 1994
purpose: The Act establishes a three-tier Panchayat Raj system for self-government and planned local development.
scope: Applies to Village, Block, and District Panchayats across Kerala.
key_provisions: Constitutes Panchayats with powers to prepare plans and implement development schemes.
Endows Panchayats with financial authority for governance.
Mandates public participation and social justice in local administration.
administration: Implemented through Local Self-Government Department and Panchayat authorities.

title: Kerala Consumer Protection Rules, 1998
purpose: The Rules provide procedures for consumer dispute redressal and protection.
scope: Apply to all consumers and service providers within Kerala.
key_provisions: Establish consumer forums for complaint adjudication.
Define complaint procedures and timelines.
Prescribe penalties for unfair trade practices and misleading advertisements.
administration: Administered by the State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission and district forums.

title: Kerala Consumer Protection Rules, 2005
purpose: These Rules supersede the 1998 Rules, detailing enhanced procedures and authorities for consumer dispute resolution.
scope: Cover consumers, manufacturers, and service providers across Kerala.
key_provisions: Streamlines complaint filing and hearing processes.
Provides for investigation and penalties for consumer rights violations.
Introduces mechanisms for awareness and education.
administration: Managed by the Consumer Affairs Department and statutory consumer commissions.

title: Kerala Land Conservancy Act, 1957
purpose: The Act prevents unauthorized occupation and misuse of Government lands in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all Government lands including roads, water bodies, and vacant lands.
key_provisions: Defines unauthorized occupation and penalties.
Provides for summary eviction and recovery of damages.
Allows imposition of assessments on illegally occupied lands.
administration: Enforced by Revenue Officers with powers of Collector under the Act.

title: Kerala Court-Fees and Suits Valuation Act, 1959
purpose: The Act specifies court fee payable on various legal documents and valuation of suits in Kerala courts.
scope: Applies to civil suits and legal documents submitted in Kerala courts.
key_provisions: Prescribes fee schedules for petitions, plaints, and appeals.
Defines valuation criteria for suits based on subject matter.
Provides exemptions and relaxation for specified categories.
administration: Administered by the State Government and judiciary registrar offices.

title: Mahatma Gandhi University Act, 1985
purpose: The Act establishes Mahatma Gandhi University as a teaching and affiliating university in Kerala.
scope: Governs Mahatma Gandhi University and its affiliated institutions.
key_provisions: Defines university governance, academic councils, and boards.
Empowers the university to confer degrees and regulate affiliated colleges.
Details financial and administrative powers.
administration: Managed by the University Syndicate and Vice-Chancellor under State supervision.

title: Kerala Private Forests (Vesting and Assignment) Act, 1971
purpose: The Act vests private forests in the State Government with provisions for their management and conservation.
scope: Applies to designated private forest lands within Kerala.
key_provisions: Transfers ownership of specified private forests to the Government.
Regulates forest management and conservation activities.
Provides compensation and transitional arrangements for owners.
administration: Implemented by the Forest Department under State Government control.

title: Kerala Land Reforms Act, 1963
purpose: The Act abolishes tenancy, imposes ceilings on land holdings, and provides for distribution of surplus land.
scope: Applies to all agricultural lands and tenants in Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines tenancy rights and protections.
Establishes land ceiling limits and procedures for surplus land distribution.
Empowers authorities to enforce land reforms and settle disputes.
administration: Implemented through Revenue Department and Land Tribunals.

title: Kerala Education Act, 1958
purpose: The Act provides for the better organisation, development, and regulation of educational institutions in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all Government and private schools providing varied educational services across Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines categories of schools, including aided, recognised, and minority schools.
Government regulates courses and grants recognition to private schools.
Mandates formation of District Education Authorities for local oversight.
Sets procedures for establishment, recognition, and funding of schools.
administration: Implemented by the State Education Department and District Educational Authorities.

title: Kerala Forest Act, 1961
purpose: The Act consolidates laws relating to forests and forest produce to protect and manage forest resources.
scope: Applies to all reserved, protected, and village forests in Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines procedures to notify and manage reserved forests.
Prohibits unauthorized activities like clearing, grazing, and tree felling.
Prescribes legal recourse and penalties for forest offenses.
Establishes rights related to forest produce and land.
administration: Enforced by the Forest Department through Forest Officers and Settlement Officers.

title: Abkari Act, 1 of 1077 (Kerala)
purpose: The Act regulates manufacture, possession, sale, transport, and import/export of intoxicating liquor and drugs.
scope: Applies throughout Kerala to all activities involving liquor and certain intoxicating substances.
key_provisions: Specifies licensing, permits, and duties related to liquor trade.
Defines offenses and penalties for illegal production and trafficking.
Regulates taxes and fees under 'Abkari Revenue'.
Provides measures for confiscation and compounding of offenses.
administration: Administered by the Excise Department and State Government authorities.

title: Kerala Advocates Clerks Welfare Fund Act, 2003
purpose: The Act establishes a welfare fund to provide retirement benefits and related assistance to advocates' clerks.
scope: Applies to advocate clerks working under registered advocates in Kerala.
key_provisions: Constitutes a Welfare Fund Board for administration and benefit disbursement.
Mandates contributions from advocates and eligible clerks.
Provides benefits including retirement, medical aid, and insurance.
Prescribes powers and duties of the fund and its officers.
administration: Managed by the Welfare Fund Board constituted under the Act.

title: Kerala Advocates Welfare Fund Act, 1980
purpose: The Act creates a welfare fund for payment of retirement and other benefits to advocates in Kerala.
scope: Covers all practising advocates registered under the Advocates Act within the State.
key_provisions: Requires contributions from advocates towards the welfare fund.
Facilitates payment of pension and other welfare benefits.
Establishes a managing board for fund administration.
Defines eligibility and procedures for benefit claims.
administration: Administered by the Welfare Fund Board constituted under the Act.

title: Kerala Anatomy Act, 1957
purpose: The Act regulates the supply and use of bodies of deceased persons for medical teaching and research purposes.
scope: Applies statewide to teaching medical institutions authorized under the Act.
key_provisions: Defines procedures to receive donated or unclaimed bodies.
Sets conditions for anatomical examination and dissection.
Specifies authorized officers and institutions.
Establishes penalties for misuse or unauthorized activities.
administration: Implemented by government-designated medical institutions and authorized officials.

title: Kerala Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 2007
purpose: The Act prevents anti-social activities by targeting criminals engaged in extortion, smuggling, racketeering, and other offenses.
scope: Applies to individuals and groups involved in gang-related and other anti-social conduct in Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines gangsters, rowdies, and categories of offenses.
Authorizes preventive detention for up to one year.
Empowers District Magistrates and police for area-specific restrictions.
Provides safeguards against misuse and sets judicial oversight.
administration: Enforced by police and district administration under State Government supervision.

title: Kerala Apartment Ownership Act, 1983
purpose: The Act regulates ownership, registration, rights, and management of apartments in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all apartment buildings constructed and registered under this Act.
key_provisions: Defines ownership shares, common areas, and ownership transfer procedures.
Mandates a Deed of Declaration with detailed apartment and land information.
Establishes associations of apartment owners for governance and management.
Regulates maintenance, expenses, and dispute resolution among owners.
administration: Administered by local authorities and competent registration offices.

title: Kerala Buildings Tax Act, 1961
purpose: The Act imposes a tax on buildings based on type, use, and location within Kerala.
scope: Applies to all buildings within municipal and local jurisdiction areas liable for tax.
key_provisions: Defines taxable buildings and valuation criteria.
Provides for assessment, collection, and appeal processes.
Specifies exemptions, penalties, and recovery of arrears.
administration: Administered by municipal and local governing bodies.

title: Kerala Building Tax Act, 1975
purpose: The Act regulates levy and collection of building tax to fund local infrastructure and services.
scope: Covers all taxable buildings in designated urban areas of Kerala.
key_provisions: Establishes methods for property valuation and tax rate fixation.
Provides for tax payment, refunds, and penalties.
Empowers authorities to enforce compliance and recover dues.
administration: Implemented by Urban Local Bodies and municipal authorities.

title: Kerala Civil Courts Act, 1957
purpose: The Act consolidates and regulates the jurisdiction and functioning of civil courts in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all civil courts throughout Kerala except High Court.
key_provisions: Defines types and ranks of civil courts and their territorial jurisdiction.
Regulates procedure including summons, trials, and appeals.
Specifies powers of Civil Judges and officers.
Provides for appointment and duties of court staff.
administration: Implemented by the State Judiciary under the supervision of the High Court.

title: Kerala High Court Act, 1958
purpose: The Act provides for the constitution, jurisdiction, and composition of the Kerala High Court.
scope: Applies to the functioning of the High Court of Kerala.
key_provisions: Sets out appointment of judges and court officers.
Defines jurisdiction including civil, criminal, and writ matters.
Establishes administrative control and rules of practice.
Specifies salaries, pensions, and leave of judges.
administration: Administered by the Governor of Kerala and Chief Justice of the High Court.

title: Kerala Land Assignment Rules, 1964
purpose: The Rules regulate the assignment of Government lands to individuals or entities in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all Government lands available for assignment.
key_provisions: Sets procedures and eligibility for land allotment.
Specifies terms and conditions for use and tenure.
Defines cancellation and recovery procedures for violations.
administration: Implemented by the Revenue Department through designated officers.

title: Travancore-Cochin Literary, Scientific and Charitable Societies Registration Act, 1955
purpose: The Act provides for the registration and regulation of literary, scientific, and charitable societies in the Travancore-Cochin region.
scope: Applies to societies formed for promoting literature, science, charity, or other useful objects within the region.
key_provisions: Requires societies to register with Registrar of Societies.
Defines powers, duties, and dissolution procedures of societies.
Prescribes penalties for default in compliance.
administration: Administered by the Registrar of Societies appointed by the government.

title: Travancore-Cochin Hindu Religious Institutions Act, 1950
purpose: The Act governs the management and administration of Hindu religious institutions.
scope: Applies to temples and endowments in the Travancore-Cochin area.
key_provisions: Regulates trusteeship, maintenance, and revenue of institutions.
Prescribes procedures for appointment and removal of trustees.
Ensures protection of temple assets and religious rites.
administration: Managed by appointed Devaswom Boards and government oversight.

title: Travancore-Cochin Medical Practitioners Act, 1953
purpose: The Act regulates medical practice, including qualifications and registration of medical practitioners.
scope: Covers all medical practitioners in the Travancore-Cochin region.
key_provisions: Establishes Medical Council for registration and discipline.
Defines qualifications required for practice.
Provides for disciplinary action and penalties.
administration: Administered by the Travancore-Cochin Medical Council.

title: Kerala Sports Act, 2000
purpose: The Act provides for promotion of sports and games and augmentation of athlete efficiency in Kerala.
scope: Applies statewide including sports organizations, athletes, and training centers.
key_provisions: Constitutes Sports Councils at State, District, and Local levels.
Empowers Councils to organize, regulate, and fund sports activities.
Authorizes construction and maintenance of sports infrastructure.
Establishes grievance redressal mechanisms and membership regulations.
administration: Administered by Kerala State Sports Council, District Sports Councils, and related bodies under Government supervision.

title: Kerala Hindu Places of Public Worship (Authorisation of Entry) Act, 1965
purpose: The Act regulates entry authorization to Hindu places of public worship to maintain decorum and safety.
scope: Applies to Hindu temples and other public worship places across Kerala.
key_provisions: Prescribes procedures for regulating entry during festivals and special occasions.
Authorizes managing committees to impose conditions for entry.
Details penalty provisions for violations.
administration: Managed by temple authorities under supervision of Devaswom Boards.

title: Kannan Devan Hills (Resumption of Lands) Act, 1971
purpose: The Act vests certain lands in the Kannan Devan Hills area with the State Government for planned development.
scope: Applies to lands specified in the Kannan Devan Hills region.
key_provisions: Transfers ownership of lands to State Government.
Regulates land use, development, and rights of previous owners.
Provision for compensation and settlement.
administration: Implemented by Revenue Department and special land administration authorities.

title: Kerala Police Act, 1960
purpose: The Act governs the constitution, powers, and duties of the Kerala Police Force.
scope: Applies to all police personnel and policing activities in Kerala.
key_provisions: Regulates recruitment, discipline, and conduct of police personnel.
Defines powers of arrest, investigation, and maintenance of public order.
Provides for community policing and internal accountability mechanisms.
administration: Administered by the Kerala Police Department under State Home Ministry.

title: Kerala Survey and Boundaries Act, 1961
purpose: The Act empowers authorities to survey lands and fix boundaries within Kerala.
scope: Applies to all land parcels and disputed boundaries in the State.
key_provisions: Authorizes Government survey officers to survey any land.
Defines procedures for settling boundary disputes.
Specifies penalties for obstructing surveys.
administration: Implemented by Revenue Department survey officials.

title: Kerala Survey and Boundaries Rules, 1964
purpose: The Rules provide detailed procedures for land surveys and demarcation of boundaries under the Survey and Boundaries Act.
scope: Applies to all land survey operations in Kerala.
key_provisions: Standardizes survey processes and documentation.
Defines responsibilities of survey officers and landowners.
Sets timelines and dispute resolution mechanisms.
administration: Enforced by Survey and Land Records officials under Revenue Department.

title: Kerala Escheats and Forfeitures Act, 1964
purpose: The Act deals with escheat and forfeiture of property in cases where owners die intestate without heirs or properties are abandoned.
scope: Applies to all such cases within Kerala.
key_provisions: Provides procedures for taking possession of such properties by the State.
Defines processes for notice, inquiry, and claims by possible heirs.
Authorizes sale or management of escheated properties.
administration: Administered by Revenue Department and State Government authorities.

title: Kannur University Act, 1996
purpose: The Act establishes Kannur University as an affiliating and teaching university.
scope: Applies to Kannur University and its affiliated institutions.
key_provisions: Defines management and academic structures.
Grants power to award degrees and regulate affiliated colleges.
Includes provisions for academic, administrative, and financial governance.
administration: Administered by University Senate, Syndicate, and Vice-Chancellor.

title: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technological University Act, 2015
purpose: The Act establishes A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technological University for technological education and research.
scope: Applies to the University and technical institutions affiliated to it.
key_provisions: Defines organizational structure including Board of Governors and Academic Council.
Grants authority to confer degrees and diplomas in technological subjects.
Facilitates research, innovation, and curriculum development.
administration: Managed by the University authorities under the State Government.

title: Kerala Finance Act, 2019
purpose: The Act enacts financial proposals of the Kerala Government for the 2019-2020 fiscal year, covering amendments to tax laws and financial regulations.
scope: Applies to all taxpayers and financial transactions subject to Kerala tax laws during the fiscal year.
key_provisions: Provides for reduction of arrears in surcharge and taxes for dues up to June 30, 2017.
Includes amendments to rates, penalties, and settlement procedures.
Authorizes tax authorities to withdraw recovery proceedings upon settlement.
Extends timelines for payment and filing with conditions.
administration: Implemented by Kerala Commercial Taxes Department and Finance Department.

title: Kerala Surcharge on Taxes Act, 1957
purpose: The Act imposes a surcharge on taxes levied under certain Acts in Kerala as an additional source of revenue.
scope: Applies to all taxpayers subject to specified tax Acts within Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines surcharge rates and calculation methods.
Specifies collection and enforcement procedures.
Provides for penalties for non-payment.
administration: Administered by the Commercial Taxes Department.

title: Kerala Stamp Act, 1959
purpose: The Act regulates the stamping of documents for legal recognition and imposes stamp duties on transactions.
scope: Applicable to specified instruments including conveyances, agreements, leases, and other legal documents in Kerala.
key_provisions: Prescribes stamp duty rates and exemptions.
Details procedures for payment and impounding of unstamped or insufficiently stamped documents.
Authorizes penalties and penalties for evasion.
administration: Implemented by the Stamp Department under the Kerala Government.

title: Kerala Local Authorities Entertainments Tax Act, 1961
purpose: The Act levies tax on entertainment activities regulated by local bodies in Kerala.
scope: Applies to exhibitions, shows, performances, and other entertainment events within local authorities' jurisdiction.
key_provisions: Defines taxable entertainment and rates of tax.
Specifies registration, collection, and penalty procedures.
Provides appeal mechanisms for disputes.
administration: Administered by local government authorities and finance departments.

title: Kerala Local Authorities Entertainments Tax Rules, 1962
purpose: The Rules provide detailed procedures for assessment, collection, and enforcement of entertainment tax under the 1961 Act.
scope: Covers all taxpayers and local authorities involved in entertainment tax within Kerala.
key_provisions: Sets guidelines for tax returns and record maintenance.
Specifies audit and inspection procedures.
Details penalty and recovery methods.
administration: Implemented by the tax authorities designated under the Act.

title: Central Sales Tax (Kerala) Rules, 1957
purpose: The Rules regulate the implementation of Central Sales Tax within Kerala.
scope: Applies to sales of goods outside the State of Kerala and inter-state sales involving Kerala-based dealers.
key_provisions: Specifies registration, returns, and payment procedures.
Defines valuation of sales and exemption categories.
Provides mechanisms for audit and dispute resolution.
administration: Enforced by Commercial Taxes Department and relevant Central Government authorities.

title: Kerala Parks, Play-fields and Open Spaces (Preservation and Regulation) Act, 1968
purpose: The Act protects parks, playgrounds, and open spaces from unauthorized encroachment and misuse.
scope: Applies to all public parks, playgrounds, and reserved open spaces in Kerala.
key_provisions: Prohibits unauthorized construction and occupation.
Empowers authorities to impose fines and restore spaces.
Defines procedures for management and preservation.
administration: Administered by Municipal and Panchayat authorities with government oversight.

title: Kerala Official Languages Act, 1969
purpose: The Act declares Malayalam as the official language of Kerala and regulates its use in administration and government communication.
scope: Applies to all official government departments, institutions, and public bodies in Kerala.
key_provisions: Mandates use of Malayalam for official purposes.
Regulates translation and publication of official documents.
Provides for training and implementation frameworks.
administration: Implemented by the Department of Official Languages and State Government.

title: Kerala University Act, 1969
purpose: The Act governs the constitution, powers, and functions of the University of Kerala.
scope: Applies to the University of Kerala and its affiliated institutions.
key_provisions: Defines academic structure, administration, and finance.
Grants powers for conferring degrees and diplomas.
Establishes authorities like Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council.
administration: Administered by University authorities under State Government supervision.

title: Kerala Farmers Debt Relief Commission Act, 2006
purpose: The Act establishes a commission to provide relief to indebted farmers in Kerala.
scope: Applies to farmers with outstanding debts and eligible under relief criteria in Kerala.
key_provisions: Constitutes Farmers Debt Relief Commission for investigation and recommendation.
Prescribes procedures for debt waiver or rescheduling.
Mandates timely disposal of relief claims.
administration: Operated by the Farmers Debt Relief Commission under the Agriculture Department.

title: Kerala Water Supply and Sewerage Act, 1986
purpose: The Act regulates construction, maintenance, and operation of water supply and sewerage systems in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all urban and rural water supply and sewerage installations in Kerala.
key_provisions: Authorizes local bodies to manage water systems and impose charges.
Defines standards for quality and safety.
Specifies penalties for unauthorized connections or pollution.
administration: Administered by Local Self Government Department and Public Health Engineering Department.

title: Kerala Forest (Vesting and Management of Ecologically Fragile Lands) Act, 2003
purpose: The Act vests ecologically fragile forest lands with the State and regulates their conservation and management.
scope: Applies to designated ecologically sensitive forest and hill areas in Kerala.
key_provisions: Transfers ownership of specified lands to Government.
Restricts mining, deforestation, and land-use change.
Enforces conservation through Forest Department and special management committees.
administration: Enforced by the Forest Department and Kerala Forest Conservation Authorities.

title: Kerala Headload Workers Act, 1978
purpose: The Act regulates employment conditions and welfare of headload workers in Kerala.
scope: Covers headload workers engaged in manual carrying of goods in public and private sectors.
key_provisions: Registers workers and controls licensing of headload business operators.
Regulates wages, working hours, and safety measures.
Establishes welfare fund, grievance redressal, and dispute settlement bodies.
administration: Managed by the Labour Department and designated welfare boards.

title: Guruvayoor Devaswom Act, 1978
purpose: The Act governs the management, administration, and affairs of the Guruvayoor temple and its assets.
scope: Applies to the Guruvayoor temple and its associated properties and endowments.
key_provisions: Regulates appointment of trustees and officers.
Controls temple rituals, finances, and property management.
Ensures protection of temple assets and devotees’ rights.
administration: Managed by the Guruvayoor Devaswom Board constituted under the Act.

title: Kerala University of Health Sciences Act, 2010
purpose: The Act establishes the Kerala University of Health Sciences to provide systematic instruction, teaching, training, and research in modern medicine, Indian systems of medicine, and allied health sciences.
scope: Applies to all medical and allied health educational institutions in Kerala affiliated or constituent to the University.
key_provisions: Creates a corporate university with powers to grant degrees and diplomas.
Regulates affiliation, academic standards, and admission procedures.
Provides for establishment of constituent and autonomous colleges.
Authorizes maintenance of hostels, research centers, and collaboration with institutions.
administration: Governed by the University authorities including the Governing Council, with headquarters at Thrissur.

title: Kerala Toddy Workers Welfare Fund Act, 1969
purpose: The Act establishes a welfare fund to provide social security and benefits to toddy workers.
scope: Covers all persons engaged as toddy workers in Kerala.
key_provisions: Mandates registration of toddy workers.
Collects contributions from toddy establishments.
Provides pensions, medical aid, and other welfare schemes.
administration: Managed by a Welfare Fund Board constituted under the Act.

title: Kerala Healthcare Service Persons and Healthcare Service Institutions (Prevention of Violence and Damage to Property) Act, 2012
purpose: The Act protects healthcare workers and institutions from violence and damage to property.
scope: Applies to all healthcare personnel and institutions in Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines offenses related to violence and damage.
Prescribes penalties including fines and imprisonment.
Ensures protection of healthcare delivery environments.
administration: Enforced by police with cooperation from healthcare authorities.

title: Kerala Industrial Single Window Clearance Boards & Industrial Township Area Development Act, 1999
purpose: The Act streamlines industrial approvals and fosters industrial township development.
scope: Applies to industrial projects and township developments in Kerala.
key_provisions: Establishes Single Window Clearance Boards for expeditious permission.
Facilitates infrastructure and industrial area planning.
Regulates township development projects and their management.
administration: Implemented by the Industries Department and relevant local authorities.

title: Travancore Cochin Insolvency Act, 1955
purpose: The Act provides for the insolvency and bankruptcy proceedings of individuals and entities.
scope: Applies to insolvent persons and firms in the former Travancore-Cochin area.
key_provisions: Defines declaration of insolvency and appointment of insolvency officers.
Regulates adjudication of debts and asset disposition.
Prescribes procedures for rehabilitation or liquidation.
administration: Administered by Insolvency Officers under judicial supervision.

title: Kerala Khadi and Village Industries Board Act, 1957
purpose: The Act establishes a board to promote and develop khadi and village industries.
scope: Covers khadi and village industries activities across Kerala.
key_provisions: Facilitates financial aid, training, and marketing support.
Coordinates policy implementation and research activities.
Provides regulatory oversight for quality and production.
administration: Managed by the Kerala Khadi and Village Industries Board.

title: Kerala Land Tax Act, 1961
purpose: The Act imposes tax on land ownership and land-use in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all land parcels liable for taxation within the State.
key_provisions: Defines taxable lands and valuation methods.
Prescribes tax rates, relaxation, and exemptions.
Regulates tax collection, appeals, and penalties.
administration: Implemented by Revenue Department officials.

title: Kerala Land Acquisition Act, 1961
purpose: The Act governs acquisition of land for public purposes with provision for compensation.
scope: Applies to acquisition proceedings initiated by Government authorities.
key_provisions: Defines acquisition process, notice, and inquiry procedures.
Mandates compensation determination and payment methods.
Provides for legal remedies and disputes resolution.
administration: Administered by Revenue Officers and District Collectors.

title: Kerala Government Land Assignment Act, 1960
purpose: The Act regulates assignment of Government land to persons under defined conditions.
scope: Applies to all Government lands offered for assignment purposes.
key_provisions: Sets eligibility, application, and allotment procedures.
Prescribes terms and conditions of land use and tenure.
Regulates cancellation and recovery from violators.
administration: Administered by the Revenue Department through designated officers.

title: Kerala State Commission For Economically Backward Classes Among Forward Communities Act, 2015
purpose: The Act establishes a Commission to identify and recommend measures for economically backward forward communities.
scope: Covers forward communities in Kerala identified as economically backward.
key_provisions: Constitutes the Commission with powers for study and recommendations.
Advises Government on schemes and concessions.
Monitors implementation of welfare policies.
administration: Commission functions under the Social Justice Department.

title: Kerala Land Reforms (Tenancy) Rules, 1970
purpose: The Rules provide procedural details relating to tenancy rights and land reforms.
scope: Apply to tenants and landholders governed by Kerala Land Reforms Act.
key_provisions: Prescribe application, inquiry, and settlement for tenancy claims.
Define rent fixation and ceiling enforcement.
Provide for recording and registration of tenancy.
administration: Processed through Revenue Department and Land Tribunals.

title: Kerala Local Authorities (Prohibition of Defection) Act, 1999
purpose: The Act prohibits defection by elected members of local authorities to uphold democratic stability.
scope: Applies to members of Panchayats, Municipalities, and Corporations in Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines disqualification criteria for defection.
Prescribes authority and procedures for declaring vacancies.
Establishes appeal and review mechanisms.
administration: Enforced by State Election Commission and concerned local bodies.

title: Kerala Lok Ayukta Act, 1999
purpose: The Act establishes authorities to investigate allegations of corruption and maladministration against public servants and government agencies in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all public servants and government bodies under State jurisdiction.
key_provisions: Provides for appointment of Lok Ayukta and Upa-Lok Ayuktas with judicial qualifications.
Defines the scope of investigations including corruption, misuse of power, and maladministration.
Empowers Lok Ayukta to summon persons, require documents, and conduct inquiries.
Mandates periodic property disclosures by public servants.
Prescribes initiation of prosecution upon finding criminal offences.
Provides safeguards against false complaints and misuse of power.
administration: The Lok Ayukta and Upa-Lok Ayuktas operate as independent statutory authorities with support staff under government rules.

title: Kerala Medical Officers Admission to Postgraduate Courses Under Service Quota Act, 2008
purpose: The Act regulates admission of medical officers to postgraduate courses in medical colleges under a service quota.
scope: Applies to medical officers employed by government or affiliated institutions in Kerala.
key_provisions: Reserves seats in postgraduate courses for eligible medical officers.
Defines eligibility criteria, admission procedures, and service bond conditions.
Provides for equitable distribution of seats and transparency in selection.
administration: Implemented by the Health & Family Welfare Department and affiliated universities.

title: Kerala Factories Rules, 1957
purpose: The Rules prescribe safety, health, welfare, and working conditions in factories in Kerala.
scope: Applicability extends to all factories operating within Kerala.
key_provisions: Mandates registration and licensing of factories.
Specifies requirements for sanitation, ventilation, and safety equipment.
Regulates working hours, overtime, employment of young persons, and hazardous processes.
Prescribes duties of occupiers and inspectors.
administration: Enforced by the Factory Inspectorate under the Labour Department.

title: Kerala Preservation of Trees Act, 1986
purpose: The Act protects specified trees from unauthorized cutting, destruction, or removal.
scope: Applies to all localities and land within Kerala including urban and rural areas.
key_provisions: Defines protected tree species and protected areas.
Requires prior permission for felling or transplanting.
Provides penalties for illegal tree cutting or damage.
Empowers authorities to impose restoration or compensatory plantation.
administration: Administered by the Forest Department and local authorities.

title: Kerala Prisons and Correctional Services (Management) Act, 2010
purpose: The Act provides for management, reform, and rehabilitation of prisoners and correctional services.
scope: Covers all prisons and correctional facilities in Kerala.
key_provisions: Defines roles and duties of prison authorities.
Prescribes rights and privileges of inmates.
Mandates reformative programs including education and vocational training.
Sets standards for health, sanitation, and discipline.
administration: Implemented by the Prisons Department under the State Home Ministry.

title: Kerala Police Act, 2011
purpose: The Act consolidates laws relating to the constitution, powers, and responsibilities of police in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all police personnel and policing activities in the State.
key_provisions: Regulates recruitment, discipline, conduct, and training of police officers.
Defines powers for maintenance of public order and investigation.
Includes provisions for accountability and public grievance redressal.
administration: Administered by the Kerala Police Department and State Home Ministry.

title: Kerala Professional Colleges or Institutions (Prohibition of Capitation Fee, Regulation of Admission, Fixation of Non-Exploitative Fee and Other Measures to Ensure Equity and Excellence in Professional Education) Act, 2006
purpose: The Act prohibits capitation fees and ensures regulated admissions and fair fees in professional colleges.
scope: Applies to all professional colleges and institutions in Kerala including medical, engineering, law, and management.
key_provisions: Bans capitation or donation-based admissions.
Regulates admission processes and fee structures.
Provides for monitoring, inspections, and penalties for violations.
Mandates transparency and equitable access.
administration: Implemented by the Education Department with oversight committees.

title: Kerala Promotion of Tree Growth in Non-Forest Areas Act, 2005
purpose: The Act promotes and regulates tree growth on non-forest lands to enhance greenery and ecological balance.
scope: Applies to all non-forest lands in Kerala including private and public properties.
key_provisions: Encourages planting and maintenance of trees by owners.
Provision for government assistance and incentives.
Regulates cutting, damage, and removal of trees.
Empowers authorities to ensure compliance.
administration: Managed by Forest and Revenue Departments along with local bodies.

title: Kerala Public Accountants Act, 1963
purpose: The Act regulates the qualifications, registration, and practice of public accountants in Kerala.
scope: Applies to individuals engaged in auditing and accounting services for public bodies.
key_provisions: Establishes registration procedures.
Defines professional standards and ethics.
Provides for penalties for misconduct or unauthorized practice.
administration: Administered by the Registrar of Public Accountants under the Finance Department.

title: Kerala Public Buildings (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants) Act, 1968
purpose: The Act provides for eviction of unauthorized occupants from public buildings and premises.
scope: Applies to all public buildings including government offices, schools, hospitals, and other institutions.
key_provisions: Defines unauthorized occupation and procedures for eviction.
Prescribes notice requirements and appeal mechanisms.
Authorizes magistrates and authorized officers to enforce eviction.
administration: Implemented by designated government departments and law enforcement agencies.

title: Kerala Public Services Act, 1968
purpose: The Act regulates conditions of service, recruitment, conduct, and discipline of public servants in Kerala.
scope: Covers all employees in the Kerala State Government service except judicial and police services unless otherwise provided.
key_provisions: Defines service rules, recruitment procedures, and classifications.
Prescribes disciplinary actions, appeals, and penalties.
Provides for retirement, pensions, and gratuity.
administration: Managed by the Kerala Public Service Commission and Administrative Department.

title: Kerala Public Service Commission (Additional Functions as respects certain Corporations and Companies) Act, 1970
purpose: The Act extends provisions of the Kerala Public Service Commission to certain government corporations and companies.
scope: Applies to specified corporations and companies under Kerala Government control.
key_provisions: Empowers PSC to conduct recruitments and promotions.
Regulates disciplinary control and appeals.
Ensures uniform service conditions across entities.
administration: Administered by Kerala Public Service Commission.

title: Kerala Recognition of Trade Unions Act, 2010
purpose: The Act provides criteria and procedures for recognition of trade unions in Kerala.
scope: Applies to trade unions representing workers in Kerala.
key_provisions: Regulates recognition based on membership and representativeness.
Defines rights and privileges of recognized unions.
Prescribes procedures for cancellation and dispute resolution.
administration: Implemented by the Labour Department and Trade Unions Registrar.

title: Kerala Recognition of Trade Unions Rules, 2011
purpose: The Rules specify procedures for trade union registration, recognition, and cancellation under the 2010 Act.
scope: Applies to trade unions operating in Kerala.
key_provisions: Details application forms, fees, and supporting documents.
Sets timelines for processing and hearing objections.
Provides guidelines for conducting elections and maintaining records.
administration: Administered by the Registrar of Trade Unions under Labour Department.

title: Kerala Record of Rights Act, 1968
purpose: The Act provides for the preparation, publication, and maintenance of the record of rights in respect of lands in Kerala, establishing legal recognition of land ownership and related interests.
scope: Extends to the entire State of Kerala and covers all landholdings subject to notification by the Government.
key_provisions: Mandates preparation of a detailed record of rights by prescribed officers, listing land description, occupancy, and interests.
Requires publication of draft records and consideration of objections within specified periods.
Allows correction of clerical errors within one year of record publication.
Provides for revision of records by appointed officers on application or suo moto.
Obligates persons with interests in land to furnish information upon official requisition, with penalties for non-compliance.
Empowers authorities to finalize and maintain records to ensure legal clarity on land rights.
administration: Implemented by prescribed officers, usually Deputy Tahsildars and Revenue Divisional Officers, under the State Government’s Department of Revenue.

purpose: Provides for the preparation of record of rights in respect of lands in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all lands in the state of Kerala.
key_provisions: Preparation of records by prescribed officers for notified areas.
Defines 'kudikidappukaran' as per Kerala Land Reforms Act, 1963.
administration: Enforced by the State Government and prescribed officers.

purpose: Consolidates and amends laws relating to recovery of arrears of public revenue in Kerala.
scope: Extends to the whole state and covers public revenue arrears on land.
key_provisions: Defines authorized officers and modes of enforcement such as attachment and sale of property.
Recovery process through Collector's authority.
administration: Collector and authorized officers enforce recovery.

purpose: Rules to implement the Kerala Revenue Recovery Act, 1968.
scope: Applies wherever the Act applies.
key_provisions: Specifies fees for demand notices, distraint, collection charges of 5% on arrears.
Subsistence allowance for arrest and detention, forms for processes.
administration: State Government enforces the rules.

act_name: Kerala Restriction on Transfer by and Restoration of Lands to Scheduled Tribes Act, 1999
purpose: Restricts transfer of lands by Scheduled Tribes members and restores possession of alienated lands to them.
scope: Applies statewide to lands owned by Scheduled Tribes members.
key_provisions: Defines competent authority (District Collector or appointed officer).
Restoration process and transfer restrictions.
administration: District Collectors and government-appointed authorities oversee enforcement.

purpose: Unifies and amends law on survival of causes of action, joint tortfeasor liability, and contributory negligence in torts.
scope: Extends to the entire state.
key_provisions: Causes of action survive the death of a person for benefit of estate.
Excludes certain causes like defamation and adultery claims.
administration: Legal framework enforced by courts.

act_name: Kerala Town and Country Planning Act, 2016
purpose: Promotes planned development and regulates growth of urban and rural areas in Kerala with focus on scientific spatial planning.
scope: Applies to the entire state of Kerala covering urban and rural areas.
key_provisions: Establishes State Town and Country Planning Board, District Planning Committees, and local planning authorities.
Mandates preparation of perspective and execution plans at state, district, and local levels.
Provides powers to implement plans, regulate land use, and control development schemes.
administration: State Government along with designated planning boards and local authorities enforce the Act.

act_name: Sree Pandaravaka Lands (Vesting and Enfranchisement) Act, 1971
purpose: Provides enfranchisement of Sree Pandaravaka lands held by landholders and vests certain Sree Pandaravaka Thanathu lands in the Government.
scope: Covers Sree Pandaravaka lands and certain associated Thanathu lands in Kerala.
key_provisions: Enfranchisement process for landholders.
Vesting of specified lands in Government ownership.
administration: State Government enforces and governs land vesting and enfranchisement.

purpose: Provides for registration and training of nurses, midwives, health visitors, and auxiliary nurse-midwives in Kerala.
scope: Applies to all nurses and midwives operating within Kerala.
key_provisions: Establishes Kerala Nurses and Midwives Council.
Defines training and registration procedures.
Specifies maintenance of registers divided into categories.
administration: Kerala Nurses and Midwives Council manages registration and regulation.

purpose: Constitutes a Special Tribunal for adjudicating land disputes and related issues in the Munnar area.
scope: Covers lands and disputes in specified villages of Munnar in Idukki District.
key_provisions: Establishes Tribunal with judicial and non-judicial members including a Senior District Judge.
Defines jurisdiction over ownership, possession, and land use disputes.
Prescribes procedures for appeals, salaries, and administrative powers.
administration: Special Tribunal constituted by the Government with judicial oversight.

purpose: Regulates procedures for the Munnar Special Tribunal established under the 2010 Act.
scope: Applies to all proceedings before the Munnar Special Tribunal.
key_provisions: Incorporates civil rules of practice where applicable.
Specifies filing fees and verification procedures.
Defines roles and responsibilities of Tribunal officers.
administration: Government administers procedures through prescribed regulations for the Tribunal.

act_name: Kottayam Electric Supply Agency (Undertaking) Acquisition Act, 1980
purpose: Vests the undertaking of Kottayam Electric Supply Agency in the Kerala State Electricity Board to unify and manage electricity supply under state control.
scope: Applies to transfer of ownership, operation, and assets of the Kottayam Electric Supply Agency.
key_provisions: Provides for acquisition of the agency’s electric supply operations and assets by the State Electricity Board.
Ensures compensation for acquisition and protects employment conditions of existing agency employees.
Facilitates coordinated electricity distribution and management within the Kottayam region.
administration: Kerala State Electricity Board enforces and manages operations post-acquisition.

purpose: constitute a Commission for Non-Resident Indians hailing from Kerala with a view to protect and safeguard their interest in the State of Kerala and to recommend remedial measures for their welfare
